summary: One line of text entry: the kit's field around the browser's own input.

disabled.description: The field cannot be changed or focused. The component disables its input.

root.note: The field: a recessed box around the input, as tall as a control. A click on it focuses the input.

input.note: A native input the author writes and marks with data-part="input" (D14). It carries the name, the value, the type and every constraint, and takes part in the form by itself.

guidance.text: The author labels the input with a label element, a form field around it, or aria-label.

An icon or a button written before or after the input sits inside the field. The component writes aria-invalid on the input once the user is due to be told, and mirrors invalid and readonly onto its root for the recipe.

notYet: More than one line of text (a textarea).
